export {};
declare global {
  interface Array<T> {
    total(): number;
  }
  interface Window {
    x: number;
  }
  var appName: string | undefined;
}
Array.prototype.total = function (this: number[]) {
  return this.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
};
console.log([1, 2, 3].total(), typeof appName);
const wrong: string = [1].total();
